_comment: rollup_profile is sent verbatim into MsgCreateClient and the Rust verifier rejects
unknown fields, so it carries exactly the five keys the client reads. There is no
ethereum_client member and no settlement field (dispute_game_factory, game_list_slot):
the attestor-trusted client verifies nothing against L1.
profile_version must match the artifact — op_attestor_v1 / base_attestor_v1 /
arbitrum_attestor_v1 — or instantiate fails with InvalidProfileVersion.
l2_header_fork must match the chain's execution-header layout: OP Stack keeps the L1
header shape, so prague; Arbitrum Nitro produces none of the post-London optional
fields and needs london. A mismatch is rejected as an invalid EVM header on every
The values below are the local devnet (run_optimism_node.sh). For OP Sepolia use
l2_chain_id 11155420 and the router address deploy_l2_contracts.sh printed.
wasm_checksum: <hex checksum of the OP client wasm, from `gaiad q ibc-wasm checksums`>
